topic: Someone finds their grandmother's engagement ring in a pawn shop
text: I never expected to wander into a little pawn shop on a slow Saturday and end up holding a piece of my family's history in my hand. There it was, nestled between a stack of vintage watches and an old, hollowed-out book—Grandma's engagement ring. The sapphire was unmistakable, a stone she'd always said held the sky within it. I ran my fingers over the engravings, each line and curve as familiar as the stories she used to tell. It needed a good cleaning, but it was undeniably hers. I looked around, the weight of the find settling in, and decided then and there that it was coming home with me.
